description: Get internal levels in seniority order before get-salaries-by-company-level. Never guess a level. Example: {"companySlugs":["google"],"jobFamilySlug":"software-engineer"}. Up to 5 companies. Sign in outside ~40 major tech companies. Never guess slugs. Use search-job-families, search-locations or search-companies. REQUIRED arguments: companySlugs, jobFamilySlug. Array-typed arguments (companySlugs) must be passed as arrays, even for a single value.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

name: get-company-levels
